title: 第三十一章 沼泽第二十九章 蚀骨鬼草
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
见对方只是静静看着，不发一言，魁梧体修咬紧后槽牙，面容因极力克制更为扭曲，喘着粗气：“您，这般年纪……呃……便知晓此毒草。”他又闷哼一声，鲜红的血迹从他唇角溢出，“道祖……道祖，那般人物……呃……定能，救……”
话音未落，更多的鲜血从他口中流出，谢清猗稍稍别开眼，没握剑的的手，指尖深深陷入肉中，她睫毛轻颤，虽然这人前面嘲讽她，可她真是一点办法也无，师尊，她不知道能否救的了他们……
沈江寒眸光冷了下来，法袍随着他的动作轻拂，向前一步挡住谢清猗，清朗的嗓音沉了下来：“先前不让摘，如今这般，又来为难我师妹。”
“确实，师妹方才说过，此毒无解。”顾怀谨走到沈江寒身旁，轻叹一声，“这位道友，莫要为难人。”
那魁梧体修听到这些话，仿佛失去抵抗一般，眼中的清明彻底消失，突然，灵力暴乱，拔地而起，大笑着朝秘境深处飞奔而去。
谢清猗从两位师兄中间探出脑袋，见忽然发疯奔走的男修，心中有些沉重，她果然无法做到修仙界的人那般看惯生死。
这时那女修走到一旁，语带笑意：“我就知道，天极仙府这等第一仙府的弟子，定然不会与我等散修一般见识。”她目光在三人身上流转，最终定在沈江寒身上，“在下苏甜，不知三位道友，如何称呼？”
“谢清猗。”谢清猗微微颔首，走到顾师兄身侧，给了他们个眼神示意，可两人仿佛没听见般。
她替人尴尬的毛病又犯了，轻咳声，“这两位是顾师兄和沈师兄。”
苏甜盈盈一礼，眼波流转间，嗓音更娇柔了些，带着恳求：“这秘境危机四伏，我独自一人，实在难保周全……不知可否让我随行？我定会谨守本分，绝不添乱。”
顾怀瑾神色如常，略一沉吟便点头应下：“可以，苏道友便随我们同行吧。”他话锋微转，语气平和却带着提醒，“不过秘境之中危机四伏，我等也未必能时时护得道友周全，丑话说在前头，还望道友心中有数。”
苏甜自是连声道谢，随即乖巧跟上谢清猗等人的脚步。一行人不再停留，绕过那几具已然气息奄奄或彻底疯癫的身影，朝着秘境更深处行去。
身后，那几名触碰鬼草的散修中已有两人气绝身亡，双目圆睁，脸上凝固着诡异笑容，周身再无半点灵气。余下的也已神智尽失，口中嗬嗬作声，在昏暗角落里手舞足蹈，疯癫而去。
众人沿着蜿蜒曲折，岔路繁多的通道小心前行。岩壁潮湿，滴滴答答的水声与远处隐隐传来的，不知名妖兽的低吼交织在一起。
前方传来杂乱的脚步声与人语，竟是遇上了另一队修士，都是在先前猾褢袭击与秘境坍塌中侥幸存活下来的各派弟子与散修。
人群汇聚，低声交谈着各自遭遇，惶然不安的气氛弥漫开来，一群人在迷宫般的秘境里如同无头苍蝇般乱转。
谢清猗忽觉脚下地势渐陡，原本平坦的甬道开始向上延伸，粗糙湿滑。微光中，可见岩壁呈现螺旋上升的纹理，一行人如同在攀爬一座隐匿于山腹之中的微缩峰峦。
待她们率先踏上最高处，眼前的景象却骤然一变，原先的坡地竟在下方化作一片望不见尽头的幽暗沼泽，泥泞的水面上不时鼓起诡异的绿色气泡，’噗’地破裂后，散出一股带着腐败气息的薄烟。
她眉心紧促，赶忙抬手用宽大的袖子遮住口鼻，差点干呕出来，目光轻扫，才发觉其他人无人去她一般，心中一惊，差点忘记自己是修士，心中暗恼，刚才的举动，应该没引起大家注意吧。
指尖轻转，一道淡蓝流光将她浑身包裹，彻底阻隔了那恶臭。

这时，有几名胆大的修士按捺不住，小心凑到沼泽边缘，伸着脖子向下张望。
更有谨慎者，已将本命飞剑或各式罗盘，令旗等法器祭出，悬于那片浑浊水域上空，来回扫动探查。灵力波动如涟漪般荡开，一番试探之下，除了令人窒息的死寂，并未引发任何异动。
见良久都无任何怪事发生，一股躁动开始在人群中弥漫。
“不过虚惊一场！”旁边一名身形高大的男修见状，语带轻蔑地笑道：“我当是什么龙潭虎穴，原来不过是片臭泥塘！何必在此浪费时间，直接御剑飞过去便是！”
他话音一落，身旁好几名修士也都纷纷出声附和，觉得此法稳妥可行。
众人屏息等待片刻，那几个率先提议的修士便迫不及待地踏上飞剑，凌空而起，化作数道遁光射向沼泽对岸。
然而，就在他们御剑飞至沼泽中心上空时，异变陡生！
“噗！噗！噗！”
数十道黏腻的肉粉色影子从看似平静的沼泽中激射而出，破空时还发出不知是什么动物的吱吱声。
谢清猗定睛一看，那竟是形如巨舌的怪虫，每只至少都有成年男子手臂长短，甚至有的能有孩童草大小，通体布满令人作呕的黑色疣状突起，在空中蠕动扭转着，却以惊人的速度缠上那几名修士的腿脚腰身。
“救！！”
惨叫声戛然而止。那些肉虫紧紧吸附在修士们身上，从虫体疯狂分泌出大量粘稠液体，顺着他们的口鼻耳窍迅速钻入覆盖。
不过喘息之间，黏液已包裹全身，并在空气中急速硬化，形成一个个完整的椭圆形茧壳，隐约还能看见其中人影绝望的挣扎着。
转瞬间，半空中凝结成数个巨大的苍白肉茧，随即直直坠入下方咕嘟冒泡的浑浊沼泽，连个浪花都未激起。
眼前这一幕，如果不是为了人设，她真想表演一个目瞪狗呆，可她自我娱乐的精神，现在更本不够用了。
只觉头皮发麻，鸡皮疙瘩全部冒起，她欲哭无泪，她超级怕虫子啊～喂！穿书大神果真不爱她。
更让她心塞的是，为什么看别的小说女主不管土著还是穿越，穿书，她们不是大杀四方，就是美男环绕，而她不是这个虫就是那个怪，来回恶心她，挑战她的底线……
一些人被空中的惨状吓得肝胆俱裂，下意识转身欲逃。
然而，他们脚下所站的山坡却毫无征兆地动了起来，传来一阵低沉而令人心底发颤的起伏，仿佛有庞然巨物在地底翻身。

content_en:
Seeing that the other party was just watching quietly without saying a word, the burly physique clenched his back molars, his face became more distorted due to his efforts to restrain himself, and he gasped: "You, at such an age... uh... know this poisonous weed." He groaned again, and bright red blood spilled from the corners of his lips, "Tao Ancestor... Tao Ancestor, a person like that... uh... can definitely save..."
Before he finished speaking, more blood flowed out of his mouth. Xie Qingyi opened her eyes for a moment. The fingertips of her hand that was not holding the sword sank deeply into her flesh. Her eyelashes trembled slightly. Although the man was mocking her, she really had no choice. Master, she didn't know if she could save them...
Shen Jianghan's eyes turned cold, his robe flicked with his movements, he took a step forward to block Xie Qingyi, and his clear voice deepened: "I wasn't allowed to take it off before, but now you are embarrassing my junior sister again."
"Indeed, junior sister just said that there is no cure for this poison." Gu Huaijin walked to Shen Jianghan and sighed softly, "Fellow Taoist, please don't make things difficult for others."
When the burly physique cultivator heard these words, he seemed to have lost his resistance, and the clarity in his eyes completely disappeared. Suddenly, his spiritual power was violent, he stood up from the ground, laughed and flew towards the depths of the secret realm.
Xie Qingyi poked her head out from between the two senior brothers. When she saw the male cultivator suddenly running madly, her heart felt a little heavy. She really couldn't be as accustomed to life and death as people in the world of immortality.
At this time, the female cultivator walked aside and said with a smile: "I know that the disciples of the first immortal palace such as Tianji Immortal Palace will definitely not have the same experience as us and other casual cultivators." Her eyes moved around the three people, and finally settled on Shen Jianghan, "Su Tian, I don't know how to call these three fellow Taoists?"
"Xie Qingyi." Xie Qingyi nodded slightly, walked to Senior Brother Gu, and gave them a look, but the two of them seemed not to hear.
Her habit of being embarrassed came back again, and she coughed lightly, "These two are Senior Brother Gu and Senior Brother Shen."
Su Tianying bowed, her eyes gleaming, her voice became softer and pleading: "This secret realm is full of dangers, and I am alone, so it is really difficult to be safe... I wonder if you can let me accompany you? I will stick to my duty and never cause trouble."
Gu Huaijin's expression remained as usual. He pondered for a moment before nodding in agreement: "Okay, Fellow Daoist Su, please come with us." He changed his subject slightly, and his tone was calm but with a reminder, "However, there are dangers in the secret realm, and we may not always be able to protect Fellow Daoist. There are ugly words ahead, and I hope Fellow Daoist is aware of it."
Su Tian thanked her profusely, and then followed Xie Qingyi and others obediently. The group of people stopped stopping, bypassing the dying or completely crazy figures, and headed deeper into the secret realm.
Behind him, two of the casual cultivators who had touched the ghost grass died of anger. Their eyes were wide open, with weird smiles on their faces, and there was no trace of aura around them. The rest have also lost all their consciousness, making hoho sounds in their mouths, dancing around in the dark corners, and going crazy.
Everyone walked carefully along the winding passage with many forks. The rock wall was damp, and the sound of dripping water was intertwined with the faint roar of an unknown monster in the distance.
Chaotic footsteps and voices came from the front, and they actually met another group of monks. They were all disciples and casual cultivators from various sects who had survived the previous attack on the cunning manor and the collapse of the secret realm.
The crowd gathered, chatting in low voices about their respective experiences. An uneasy atmosphere filled the air, and a group of people wandered around like headless flies in the maze-like secret realm.
Xie Qingyi suddenly felt that the terrain under his feet was getting steeper, and the originally flat corridor began to extend upwards, becoming rough and slippery. In the dim light, it can be seen that the rock wall shows a spiral texture, and the group seems to be climbing a miniature peak hidden in the heart of the mountain.
When they took the lead to step onto the highest point, the scene in front of them suddenly changed. The original slope turned into an endless dark swamp below. Weird green bubbles swelled from time to time on the muddy water. After popping, a stream of water erupted.Thin smoke with the smell of corruption.
She frowned and quickly raised her hands to cover her mouth and nose with her wide sleeves. She almost retched. She glanced around and realized that no one else was paying attention to her. She was shocked and almost forgot that she was a monk. She was secretly annoyed that her actions just now probably didn't attract everyone's attention.
With a slight twist of her fingertips, a stream of light blue light enveloped her whole body, completely blocking the stench.
At this time, a few bold monks couldn't hold themselves back and carefully approached the edge of the swamp, stretching their necks and looking down.
The more cautious ones have taken out their natal flying swords or various compasses, flags and other magic weapons, hung them over the turbid waters, and swept them back and forth to investigate. The spiritual power fluctuated like ripples, and after some testing, except for the suffocating silence, it did not cause any abnormal movement.
Seeing that nothing strange happened for a long time, a restlessness began to spread among the crowd.
"It's just a false alarm!" Seeing this, a tall male cultivator next to him said with a contemptuous smile: "I thought it was some kind of dragon pond and tiger's den, but it turned out to be just a smelly mud pond! Why waste time here, just fly over with your sword!"
As soon as he finished speaking, several monks around him also echoed, feeling that this method was safe and feasible.
Everyone waited with bated breath for a moment, and the monks who were the first to propose couldn't wait to step on the flying swords, rise into the sky, and turn into several rays of light that shot towards the other side of the swamp.
However, just as they flew over the center of the swamp with their swords, a sudden change occurred!
"Poof! Poof! Poof!"
Dozens of sticky flesh-pink shadows shot out from the seemingly calm swamp, making the squeaking sound of an unknown animal as they broke through the air.
Xie Qingyi took a closer look and saw that they were strange insects shaped like giant tongues. Each one was at least as long as an adult man's arm, and some could even be as big as a child's grass. Their whole body was covered with disgusting black wart-like protrusions. They squirmed and twisted in the air, but wrapped around the legs, feet and waist of the monks at an alarming speed.
"Help!!"
The screams stopped abruptly. The flesh worms clung to the monks' bodies, secreting a large amount of viscous liquid frantically from their bodies, and quickly penetrated and covered their mouths, noses, and ears.
However, while gasping for breath, the mucus had wrapped around the whole body and hardened rapidly in the air, forming complete oval cocoons, in which figures could still be vaguely seen struggling desperately.
In an instant, several huge pale flesh cocoons condensed in mid-air, and then fell straight into the turbid and bubbling swamp below without even stirring up a wave.
In the scene in front of her, if it weren't for the sake of character, she really wanted to act dumbfounded, but her spirit of self-entertainment was not enough now.
She felt her scalp was numb and goosebumps appeared. She wanted to cry but had no tears. She was super afraid of bugs~ Hey! The book master really doesn't love her.
What makes her even more upset is why when reading other novels, whether the heroines are indigenous or have traveled through time and space, they are either killing everyone or surrounded by beautiful men, while she is either a bug or a monster, disgusting her and challenging her bottom line...
Some people were so frightened by the tragedy in the air that they subconsciously turned around and tried to escape.
However, the hillside they stood on moved without warning, and there was a low and heart-shaking ups and downs, as if a huge thing was turning over underground.
